svg.title: EndPoint broker mode
svg.desc: An EndPoint in broker mode runs remote checks on four devices and sends one XML file per device to the Pandora FMS server, where each device appears as its own agent.

g.text: Monitoring remote devices with an EndPoint in broker mode
One EndPoint checks several devices and reports each one to the server as its own agent
Shows each device as its own agent
Sent to the server in each cycle
